nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file enumerating all backend configuration variables — database connection, JWT secrets, upload settings, third-party API keys (Immich, OpenWeatherMap, AviationStack, OpenRouteService), Nominatim geocoding, SMTP, and the frontend URL — for local setup.

nodes.name: Dockerfile.prod
nodes.summary: Multi-stage production Dockerfile for the backend: compiles the TypeScript app and generates the Prisma client in a builder stage, then produces a minimal Node.js 20 Alpine runtime image running as a non-root user with a health check and a migration-aware entrypoint script.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the multi-stage build pattern to keep dev dependencies and build tooling out of the final runtime image, copying only the compiled dist/ output and production node_modules forward.

nodes.name: cUsersdsbactsc_output.txt
nodes.summary: Stray captured text output (its mangled filename suggests a Windows `tsc` compiler run redirected to a file) rather than an intentional part of the application source; not present on disk at analysis time.

nodes.name: docker-entrypoint.sh
nodes.summary: Docker container entrypoint script that waits for the database to become available, detects and auto-resolves failed Prisma migrations (rollback retries, schema-push fallback, stale migration-record cleanup), then execs the container's main startup command.

nodes.name: resolve_migration
nodes.summary: Marks a specific named Prisma migration as rolled back via `prisma migrate resolve --rolled-back` so it will be re-applied on the next deployment attempt.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Backend npm package manifest defining scripts (dev, build, build:strict, test, prisma:generate/migrate/studio) and the full set of runtime and dev dependencies for the Express + TypeScript + Prisma backend.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Base TypeScript compiler configuration for the backend, defining module resolution, output directory, and include/exclude patterns used by the default dev and build scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.prod.json
nodes.summary: Relaxed production TypeScript configuration, extending the base tsconfig, used by `npm run build` so that non-blocking type errors don't fail the production build.

nodes.name: tsconfig.test.json
nodes.summary: Minimal TypeScript configuration, extending the base tsconfig, that scopes compilation to test files for Jest test runs.
